details: So like I was with my ex for 3 year's an at the time we did matching user name's but when the brake up happened I changed my name way I was well sad, So I'm currently frustrated with vrchat's name change system, the reason being is because when I broke up with my ex-boyfriend while he broke up with me I changed my name to a name that I'm not really happy with now I'm stuck with it for 3 months and I'm no longer in that mindset. I understand making people wait a month but three is a little ridiculous, look sometimes people are in a bad place and change their name I mean I went 3 years without changing my name I feel like that should give me a little bit of freaking leeway I understand that they don't want people changing their name every freaking day, but why is it only one time. What's the point in being able to revert your name to me you don't want like I don't want to be the matching name that I have with my ex I just don't want the stupid name I picked after that because I was upset. And it sucks having to wait 3 months to fix a mistake, you have to understand most of the time people want to change their username for one of three reasons. One they broke up with their partner and they had matching last name, two drama and they blocked and removed people and don't want people to be able to look them up anymore based off their name meaning they're trying to not have to delete their whole account to get away from toxic people because hitting the block button doesn't work but changing your name does. So it's kind of essential with the toxic community that is VR chat to be able to change our names to get away from bullshit and drama. At the end of the day you're only making it harder, for people that genuinely need it. So rather than making it to where you can't change your name but every 3 months why don't you just give us three change tokens before that, so when you have those people that are changing their name too often you know the difference between them and someone that genuinely it's like oh I just picked a stupid username. Like come on I ended up with the name Loveless because I was depressed now I'm stuck with that for 3 months, it's kind of annoying and ridiculous. I'm not one of those people who is changing their name 20 times a day. I understand to a degree why it's there because it's deter people from changing their name all the freaking time but the reality is even with you putting the timer on it people who change their name all the time or just going to change their name every 3 months versus people who genuinely just want a new name to get away from bullcrap now have to be super careful and like I said most of the time when they go to change their name they're going to be distraught crying and or upset and then they're going to get stuck with something that's stupid and then end up wanting to kill themself because they're stuck with a dumb name for 3 months so could you like I don't know cut it some slack and not make it so stupid
title: Why do we have to wait so long to change our user name
